tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find electronics and their live prices across a market's shops (Lebanon by default in USD; the Gulf, Jordan and Egypt via `market`, in local currency; re-checked nightly). Returns up to 10 products, most widely sold first, each with its lowest price, how many shops sell it, and its page. Laptops als

tools.name: get_product_prices
tools.description: Live per-shop prices for ONE product: every shop in its market that has the identical configuration in stock, cheapest first, with links to the shop's own product page. Takes a product id or a lebtechlb.com / priceteq.com product or laptop URL.

tools.name: cheapest_in_category
tools.description: The cheapest products currently in stock in a category in one market (Lebanon by default; laptops: cheapest among sensible, new machines first). Optional budget and brand. Up to 10 results.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: How the lowest price of one product across its market's shops moved over the last ~90 days: current low, period low/high, the drop since tracking began, and weekly lows. Takes a product id or a lebtechlb.com / priceteq.com product or laptop URL.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
